title: Jan Aushadhi / Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Government initiative providing quality generic medicines at lower prices through Jan Aushadhi Kendras; it reduces medicine costs but is not health insurance.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Medicines are available to the general public subject to prescription and pharmacy availability.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Jan Aushadhi / Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
